item.text: {"prompt":"A square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire image edge to edge, with no border or frame. Build a charged field of deep ultramarine, bruised violet, and near-black, interrupted by sharp currents of vermilion, hot coral, and pale electric yellow. Use dense, scraped layers and restless dry-brush marks that gather into compressed knots, then break apart into broad, quiet expanses of translucent blue-gray. Let vigorous diagonal gestures cross and interrupt one another, with fine granular textures caught beneath glossy sweeps and occasional raw patches where the underlayers show through. Balance agitation and restraint: a dense, luminous concentration slightly off center, with generous but uneasy empty space pressing in from one side. Keep every mark purely abstract and nonreferential; include no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. No setting, wall, room, or gallery—only the square painting."}
